name: turtle-games
description: Build pipeline for Turtle's WebView games. Each game is a Vite build that emits a SINGLE self-contained HTML file (CSS + JS + bridge shim all inlined) via vite-plugin-singlefile. Output lands in dist/<game>/index.html and gets bundled into the Android APK at app/src/main/assets/games/<game>/index.html by Gradle's copyGamesHtml task. No hosting, no network for the shell.
